subject: Request: seniority lane exception for Platform Eng candidate (Alex Torres)
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: seniority lane exception for Platform Eng candidate (Alex Torres)

Team —

We have a strong candidate for the Platform Engineer role (requisition #PLT-2028-021) who is asking for a seniority lift. The req is posted as L5 but Alex Torres' experience and counterpressure from market comp warrant an L6 offer. Quick summary:

- Candidate: Alex Torres (ex-CloudScale, senior infra lead)
- Role: Platform Engineer (platform infra team)
- Proposed band: L6 (lane exception to requisition)
- Proposed terms: base $205,000, equity 0.60% (4y), sign-on $25,000, relocation $10,000 (if needed)
- Budget code: 230-PLT-INFR-01
- Headcount slot: 1 (we plan to convert a contractor seat this quarter if approved)

Why this exception: Alex has 7+ years running distributed storage and has led critical KV cache/latency projects — the technical lift will shorten our roadmap by ~3 months on the K/V cache initiative. Recruiting has flagged that if we don’t match market L6 offers we’ll lose them; they have an active competing offer.

Request: Kimberly — can you route this to the compensation committee and confirm whether you need a full comp exception packet? I’ve attached a draft offer and a filled comp rationale (quick notes). Marcus and Mina are looped for technical signoff; Soojin I’ve cc’d for visibility in case this hits exec exception territory.

If we can get sign-off by EOD Tuesday (5/29) we can close before the counter. I can also route funding (convert contractor) if that helps — note in the draft I included the budget reallocation details.

Attachments: draft_offer_alex_torres.pdf, comp_committee_form.xlsx (stub attached)

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Hiring Lead, Platform Infra
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-28T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: seniority lane exception for Platform Eng candidate (Alex Torres)

Diego —

Thanks for the quick note and the packet. A few items I need to move this to comp committee:

1) Please confirm Alex’s current total target (break out base / bonus / equity) and the competing offer cadence.
2) Complete the attached comp_committee_form.xlsx with the business rationale, org impact, and approval route (is this an org headcount swap or an incremental seat?).
3) If the proposed total cash + sign-on pushes us above the L6 cap in this banding, Finance will need to sign off — please include the budget code (you did) and the proposed funding shift in the form.

Our committee meets Tues/Thurs; I’ll add this to the Tuesday agenda if you can get the completed form to me today. If this is truly time-sensitive we can do an expedited review but I need the completed form and the benchmark doc (comp_benchmark_q2.pdf) you mentioned.

I’ve attached the comp committee template I’ll use — fill out the 'Comp Rationale' and 'Alternative options' tabs.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Total Rewards | People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-05-28T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: seniority lane exception for Platform Eng candidate (Alex Torres)

+1 from me. Diego called out the impact on the K/V cache milestone — Alex’s background maps cleanly to the gap we have. A couple operational notes:

- I can free the headcount by converting contractor C-192 into a perm headcount; recruiting has flagged the contractor is ready to transition and we have the runway in Q3 budget to support it. That keeps us budget-neutral for FY28.
- If comp committee prefers, we can reduce sign-on to $20k and make an accelerated equity vesting schedule (25% first-year cliff + monthly thereafter) to present a lower cash ask.

Diego — I’ve pasted below the candidate snippet you sent and will stand behind escalation to Kimberly/Finance. Please put the completed comp form in the Drive folder and ping me when it’s there.

> Candidate: Alex Torres — ex-CloudScale, led distributed storage + KV cache projects; actively interviewing elsewhere.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Engineering Manager, Platform Infra

Subject: Re: Request: seniority lane exception for Platform Eng candidate (Alex Torres)

Thanks all — I backed Marcus's plan to convert the contractor and confirm we have the operational coverage to do so. I uploaded a short benchmarking memo to the Drive (comp_benchmark_q2.pdf) that compares Alex’s ask to peer L6 offers in the market (SF Bay). Key callouts: base at $205k is within 60-70th percentile for our comps when equity at 0.6% is factored in.

If Kimberly needs anything else from engineering (screens, tech assessment notes), I can compile a one-pager for the committee this morning.

Mina

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-29T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: seniority lane exception for Platform Eng candidate (Alex Torres)

Approvable exception — precedence notes below.

I reviewed the packet and Mina’s benchmark. Given the delivery risk on the K/V cache work and Marcus’s willingness to convert contractor C-192, I approve elevating the requisition to L6 for this candidate only. Conditions:

- Final approved terms: base $205,000; equity 0.60% 4y; sign-on $20,000 (reduced from $25k to keep cash exposure lower).
- Offer must include accelerated vesting language (25% after 9 months) and standard exec exception clause.
- Finance must sign off on the budget reallocation before the offer is extended. Kimberly, please route to Finance and DocuSign the final offer.
- Diego: extend the counter with the revised sign-on and request acceptance by 72 hours (candidate has a competing offer).

Kimberly — feel free to escalate if Finance rejects the reallocation; if that happens we’ll table for exec approval. Please confirm when DocuSign is live so I can close loop with Recruiting.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Platform Engineering
